title: Diamond: each carbon bonded to four
caption: In diamond every carbon atom is covalently bonded to four others in a tetrahedral giant lattice, which is why it is so hard and has a very high melting point. The cubic cell holds eight carbon atoms.
alt: A cubic unit cell of diamond: atoms at the corners and face centres, and four more inside the cell.
description: Carbon atoms on the eight corners and six face centres of a cube.
Four more atoms inside, each bonded tetrahedrally to four neighbours.
